components.copyright: The upstream files do not carry a separate copyright line (Apache-2.0)
components.how: bounded_text, bounded_metadata and the newest-first page translated from apps/server/src/audit.rs to rusqlite (WP-78). The 90-day keep, the initiator and the activity screen are Hivra's.

components.name: Orbit trash
components.copyright: The upstream files do not carry a separate copyright line (Apache-2.0)
components.how: Page and task trash rules (a batch shares one deleted_at and one trashed_with, a 30-day purge, a restored child of a still-trashed parent comes back at the top level) translated onto one trash_items ledger. Orbit's SQL is sqlx against tasks and pages tables Hivra does not have (WP-76)

components.name: Orbit docs editor
components.copyright: The upstream files do not carry a separate copyright line (Apache-2.0)
components.how: The docs editor's link rules, slash menu, content checks, page tree and Markdown conversion, copied from Orbit and restyled for Hivra (WP-72). The blank line before a list item's paragraph, quote or heading child, and before a numbered list that does not start at 1, comes from Orbit's ab86dac (WP-102)

components.name: Orbit's task rules
components.copyright: The upstream files have no file-level copyright line. See src/features/tasks/vendor/LICENSE.
components.how: tasksLib.ts, taskMeta.ts, subIssuesLib.ts, bulkUpdates.ts and relationsLib.ts copied with their tests (WP-70). The view files viewState, grouping, filterTree, filterFields, layoutGroups, taskTree, nestDrop, useCollapsedGroups, autosave, displayMeta and timelineLib, and their tests, are copied from apps/web/src/features/views (WP-71). viewActions is rewritten because Hivra has no toast or workspace switch. The parent check, the auto-close rule and the version check are translated from the Rust repositories to rusqlite. Saved views are translated from views.rs. Hivra does not close descendants, store relations, or add a duplicate status category.

components.name: Orbit home layout
components.copyright: The upstream files have no file-level copyright line. See src/features/tasks/vendor/LICENSE.
components.how: The home column width (960), the card limit (7) and the view-bar-enter timing (180ms, the same ease, a 4px rise, sections staggered by 40ms), copied from apps/web/src/features/home/pages/HomePage.tsx and apps/web/src/index.css. HomePage.tsx shows counters, status icons and view-all links that WP-73 forbids, so it was not vendored whole (WP-73).

components.name: Orbit's search index
components.copyright: The upstream files do not carry a separate copyright line (Apache-2.0)
components.how: The FTS5 schema, fts_query, split_marks, the bm25 and snippet query, and the integrity-check confirmation are translated from migrations/0027_page_search_fts.sql, apps/server/src/repositories/pages.rs and crates/platform/src/integrity.rs onto rusqlite (WP-74). The title weight, the 24-token snippet and the 16-term cap are Orbit's. A 200-character cap is Hivra's, from Orbit's feature notes, and is not in pages.rs.

components.name: Orbit's GitHub label sync
components.copyright: The upstream files do not carry a separate copyright line (Apache-2.0)
components.how: The label match and sync_github_work_item rules, translated from the GitHub webhook onto rusqlite and a poll (WP-77). A title over 300 characters or a description over 12,000 is rejected, not stored. A labelled pull request drops only its own row in github_pull_links, so a crew pull request on a different task can still complete that task.

The cloud transport (login and a token) is replaced by a loopback port on this Mac (WP-85).

components.name: portless's route registry, labels and proxy
components.how: WP-90: routes.ts, auto.ts, compose.ts and proxy.ts translated line by line to Rust, with their tests. TLS, the /etc/hosts sync and the sudo path are not included.

components.name: emulate's base URLs and file store
components.how: WP-90: base-url.ts and persistence.ts translated to Rust with their tests. The 14 emulators themselves run as a pinned npm package and are not copied.

components.name: T3 Code's hidden-character pattern
components.how: sanitizeLinkedPrompt from packages/shared/src/promptLinks.ts translated to TypeScript and to Rust, with its tests, at commit 6577c6b (WP-94). The character classes are the original's; the URL parts of that file are not copied. A zero-width joiner stays only between two emoji, as in the original.

components.name: T3 Code's project monogram
components.how: projectMonogram and projectColor from apps/web/src/projectIdentity.ts translated to TypeScript, with their cases in projectMonogram.test.ts, at commit 6577c6b (WP-94). The letters and the colour hash are the original's; the tile's colours come from Hivra's theme. One rule differs: a one-letter name stays one letter, where the original draws it twice.

components.name: oh-my-hermes's dag-ulw planner
components.how: dag_core.py translated line by line to Rust (topology.rs) with test_dag_core.py's cases ported, and dag_run.py's record rules — the hard rejects over a graph, the repair caps and the re-plan cycle, the handoff refusal, the goal verdict and the lint findings — translated into record.rs and plan.rs, at commit 2676c33 (WP-91). The Hermes-only tool, scope hook and TUI are not copied. One rule differs: Hivra refuses only a pair that can really run at the same time, where dag-ulw treats two nodes as ordered only when one names the other directly.

components.name: OpenMausBot's turn watchdog sleep rule
components.copyright: Copyright 2026 Milind Soni and OpenMausBot contributors
components.how: server/turn-watchdog.ts's sleep guard (e39d9b0d7, da0309f6c) translated to TypeScript: a look that arrives more than three intervals late is read as the computer having slept, and each running worker's clock moves forward by the gap instead of being stopped. Hivra keeps one interval of the gap as the tick's own, so a stall is still caught up to one tick late (WP-102). The rule lives in classifier.ts beside SILENCE_MS, so the headless watcher and the half-minute look share it.

components.name: Row-Bot's memory policy
components.how: memory_policy.py translated to TypeScript, its test cases ported, for WP-99. The semantic and graph score terms are folded into lexical matching, because Hivra has no embeddings and no graph; the store is scored in one pass rather than through a SQLite candidate query; Row-Bot's memory statuses become Hivra's: a fact with a removal waiting is archived, one with an update waiting is superseded, and an unreviewed proposal needs review.

components.name: Row-Bot's correction rule
components.how: learning/corrections.py translated line for line to TypeScript for WP-103, with its correction, not-a-correction and ambiguous cases ported to ruleCurator.test.ts. The store, episode and signal parts are left out because Hivra judges one turn at a time; the `<row_bot_turn_context` cut, the first-400-characters retraction window, the defect and asking sentence rules and the conservative order are the original's. Hivra adds its own fact detector beside it (remember that, from now on, always, never).

components.name: Mnemos's lived-day clock
components.how: LivedClock translated line by line from mnemos/consolidation/lived.py to TypeScript (WP-100), with tests/test_lived_time.py's cases ported to fade.test.ts. L(t), the hours into a lived day, the two bisections and the never-below-0 clamp are the original's; a moment is a Date or an ISO string rather than a datetime, unreadable days are dropped on the way in, and the store class is gone. The fade curve, the two clocks and the ask are Hivra's own.

components.name: T3 Code's PR watch, Claude result and worktree cleanup rules
components.how: evaluatePullRequestWatch ported to Rust (eval.rs), terminalStatusFromResult, providerFailureFromResult and claudeWorkflowProgress translated to TypeScript, and storageCleanup.ts's cases ported to the worktree janitor, at commit 2532e640.

components.name: T3 Code's recorded Claude transcripts
components.how: 18 recorded Claude transcripts (orchestration-v2/testkit/fixtures at 2532e640) replayed through the live adapter by claudeFixtureReplay.test.ts and the fake Claude; T3's LICENSE sits beside them.
